title: Constitutional adapters: Inference-time interventions for misalignment and misuse
abstract: arXiv:2609.36657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training models to act in accordance with an explicitly defined set of principles, or "constitution," has shown promise as a robust and transparent mechanism for AI alignment. However, the generality and flexibility of such methods remain unclear. Here, we show that constitution-consistent behavior can be distilled from synthetic corpora into lightweight objects (low-rank adapters and steering vectors). Despite never seeing a harmful request or jailbreak during training, such objects increase jailbreak defense success and measured alignment -- particularly at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks, where they outperform both prompted and steered baselines. Subtracting control-trained from constitution-trained objects further accentuates these effects, yielding defenses we call "constitutional adapters" (CAs). CAs can be trained on a base model, transferred zero-shot to its post-trained checkpoint, and scaled at inference t

translated_title: 宪法适配器：针对失调与滥用的推理时干预方法
translated_abstract: 训练模型遵循明确定义的一套原则（即“宪法”），已被证明是一种稳健且透明的AI对齐机制。然而，这类方法的通用性和灵活性仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们展示了宪法一致的行为可以从合成语料库中蒸馏到轻量级对象中（低秩适配器和引导向量）。尽管在训练过程中从未接触过有害请求或越狱攻击，这些对象仍能提高越狱防御成功率和测得的对齐水平——特别是在长上下文长度和面对多轮攻击的场景下，其表现优于基于提示和基于引导的基线方法。将控制训练的对象从宪法训练的对象中减去，进一步强化了这些效果，由此产生了我们称之为“宪法适配器”的防御方法。宪法适配器可以在基础模型上训练，零样本迁移到其后训练检查点，并可在推理时进行扩展。
tldr: 本文提出“宪法适配器”（CAs），通过将宪法一致行为从合成语料库蒸馏到轻量级低秩适配器和引导向量中，实现在推理时对越狱攻击的有效防御，尤其在长上下文和多轮攻击场景下优于现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Constitutional Adapters (CAs), lightweight low-rank adapters and steering vectors distilled from constitution-consistent synthetic corpora, which enable inference-time jailbreak defense and improved alignment, outperforming prompted and steered baselines especially at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks.
